findings.ref: AP-05/AP-03 under RET-02 load, checklist item 4 (guard)
findings.problem: The test asserts only 'no Seq Scan'. Dropping the new index (tenant_id, created_at) keeps all tests green: at 100k rows the planner scans the tenant part of (tenant_id, requester_principal, created_at) (1283 buffers, 5.3 ms vs 0.06 ms); at 500k it becomes a 52 ms Seq Scan. No effective guard of index-boundedness existed in cycle 1 either; the checklist asked for the queries and EXPLAIN evidence, both delivered.
